answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward a new agent earns stays locked for 30 epochs and vests linearly, while any attestation it gives during that window can be slashed from the locked pool. An attacker spinning up 500 identities must front 500 sets of compute, then wait a month before cashing anything, and a single fraud signal claws back the whole stack. Like a lotus rooted in mud, honest agents grow slowly; a sybil ring is an onyx brick sinking under its own cost.
